manual_notes: Detached scheduled retry, persisted retry diagnostics, manual bypass and normal 30-minute success throttle are implemented. However the requirement says at most one auto upload attempt every30 minutes: failure records only a60-second initial backoff and internal ingest retries can occur sooner, so the strict attempt-based cadence is not established. This is a contract mismatch, not evidence of abandonment.
